name: AI-Code-Tutorials
headline: AI-Code-Tutorials: 从零基础到高级应用
short_description: AI-Code-Tutorials provides a structured learning path for Claude Code, enabling developers to master AI-assisted programming. It benefits operations teams by improving coding efficiency and productivity. The skill connects to Claude agents and integrates with existing development workflows.
author: 0xfnzero

sections.overview:
AI-Code-Tutorials is a complete learning curriculum designed to teach Claude Code proficiency across three progressive levels: beginner, intermediate, and advanced. The tutorials cover foundational concepts, installation and configuration, hands-on project development, and professional techniques including prompt optimization and AI sub-agent systems. Developers use this structured path to master AI-assisted programming workflows, implement best practices, and increase coding efficiency through systematic training modules and real-world project exercises.
Learning Claude Code from zero programming experience
Building full-stack web applications with AI assistance
Mastering prompt engineering for AI-assisted development
Setting up AI sub-agent teams for specialized development roles
